title: fix: regenerate packages/sdk lockfile and guard against future drift
author: gggff123
pr_body_excerpt:
- Regenerates `packages/sdk/package-lock.json` so it matches the React 19 SDK manifest and includes the complete Vitest dependency tree.
- Adds a targeted isolated `npm ci` guard when the SDK manifest or local lockfile changes.
- Documents the required standalone lockfile regeneration command.

Verified:
- `npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefix packages/sdk`
- SDK build
- 46 SDK tests
- SDK typecheck
- All GitHub checks

Closes #13858

gist.headline: The lockfile found its key
gist.blurb: The SDK's React 19 lockfile has been replanted from a clean install, with the full Vitest branch intact. A small CI bee now checks the garden before drift can spread.
gist.summary: Regenerated packages/sdk/package-lock.json to match the React 19 manifest and complete Vitest dependency tree, then added an isolated npm ci CI check whenever the SDK manifest or lockfile changes.
gist.impact: SDK contributors get reproducible standalone installs and an early CI warning if package.json and package-lock.json drift apart again.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful gardener-mechanic using a tiny key to align a package-lock scroll with an SDK seed packet labeled React 19, while a friendly CRT monitor robot verifies the matching pieces at a terminal. Small code-plants and neatly sorted dependency tiles represent the restored dependency tree and future CI guard.
